## Services

- Cross-platform app development: Flutter apps for iOS, Android and web, from prototype to store release.
- AI features for products: chat assistants, smart search and automation using LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows via Python/FastAPI services.
- Architecture, audits and rescue: scalable foundations, state management, performance on low-end devices, legacy refactoring.
- Release and CI/CD: build pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod flavors, App Store Connect and Google Play publishing.

## Experience

- Flutter Engineer — LogicEra (Cloud & AI Partner), Dubai, UAE (remote), Oct 2025 – present.
- Senior Software Engineer (Cross-Platform) — Al Taif Group, Islamabad, Pakistan, Mar 2022 – Oct 2025. Led an engineering team on enterprise delivery and e-commerce apps serving thousands of active users; designed modular architectures; built CI/CD and multi-flavor environments; owned App Store and Google Play releases; ran code reviews and performance audits.
- Software Engineer (Flutter) — Turing, remote, part-time, Aug 2023 – Dec 2023. Full-stack marketplace features with Python, Django REST Framework, Docker and PostgreSQL; Riverpod state management; CI/CD and build flavors.
- Software Engineer (Flutter) — AppWowZap, Apr 2021 – May 2022. Flutter and React Native apps; POS thermal printing via method channels; real-time messaging, Stripe payments and Google Maps; FCM push notifications.
- Software Engineer (Flutter) — EmCentrix, Nov 2019 – Apr 2021. TDD and automated testing; early CI/CD; greenfield Flutter apps and refactoring legacy native Android code.

## Selected projects

- [Ticket Wallet](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ticket-wallet/id6463562809): iOS & Android ticket marketplace with AI-assisted listing and pricing; 4.8 rating on the App Store. Also on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=co.ticketwallet.application).
- [TFM Courier 2](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tfmexpress.courier.tfmcourier): Android field app for delivery riders — scanning, location tracking, offline-tolerant sync; 5K+ installs, 4.4 rating.
- [TFM Shipper 2](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tfmexpress.shipper.tfmshipper): Android customer shipping app — booking, tracking and support; 4.4 rating.
- [Recall App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mtbahauddin.recall): personal offline-first media tracker built solo with Flutter, BLoC and Hive.
